Activates the button.

x-examples.title: Variants
x-examples.description: One primary action per view; secondary and ghost for the rest; danger for destructive actions.
x-examples.code:
<va-button>Save changes</va-button>
<va-button variant="secondary">Cancel</va-button>
<va-button variant="ghost">Learn more</va-button>
<va-button variant="danger">Delete project</va-button>

x-examples.title: Sizes
x-examples.description: Every size meets the WCAG 2.2 target size of 24 by 24 pixels.

x-examples.title: Disabled and loading
x-examples.description: Disabled buttons can't be focused. Loading buttons stay focusable, so the user keeps their place.

x-examples.title: With icons
x-examples.description: Decorative icons are aria-hidden. An icon-only button needs label.
x-examples.code:
<va-button variant="secondary">
  <svg slot="start" aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>
  New article
</va-button>
<va-button variant="ghost" label="Close">
  <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg>
</va-button>

x-examples.title: In a form
x-examples.description: type="submit" submits the form with name=value; the default type="button" never submits.

declarations.description:
A region for short, non-blocking status messages ("toasts"). Place one per page and call `show()`,
or point a `va-button` at it with `command="--show"`; the button's `value` is the message.
declarations.name: VaToast

cssParts.description: The fixed area the toasts appear in.
cssParts.name: region

members.name: duration
members.description: Milliseconds before an info or success message closes by itself. Errors stay until dismissed.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the region.

members.name: open
members.description: True while at least one message is showing.

members.name: show
members.description: Shows a message and returns its id. `variant` defaults to `info`; errors stay until dismissed.

members.name: dismiss
members.description: Closes one message by id, or every message when no id is given.

events.name: va-close
events.description: When a message closes. `event.detail.reason` is `timeout`, `dismiss`, `escape` or `method`.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Milliseconds before an info or success message closes by itself. Errors stay until dismissed.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the region.

declarations.summary: Shows short status messages, such as "Changes saved", without interrupting the user.

x-keyboard.description: Dismisses the message that has focus.

notes: Info and success messages are announced politely; errors use `role="alert"` and are announced at once.
Messages pause their timer while hovered or focused, and errors stay until dismissed (WCAG 2.2.1).
x-a11y.name: The `label` attribute, "Notifications" by default.

x-guidance.use: To confirm that something happened, such as "Changes saved" or "Link copied", or to report a background failure.
x-guidance.avoid: For anything the user must act on or read in full, or for form validation errors.

x-commands.name: --show
x-commands.description: Shows the sending button's `value` as a message; its `data-variant` sets the look.

x-examples.title: Status messages
x-examples.description: Place one va-toast per page. A va-button with commandfor and command="--show" sends its value as the message; data-variant sets the look.
x-examples.code:
<va-button commandfor="toaster" command="--show" value="Changes saved" data-variant="success">Save</va-button>
<va-button variant="secondary" commandfor="toaster" command="--show" value="Link copied">Copy link</va-button>
<va-button variant="danger" commandfor="toaster" command="--show" value="Couldn't sync. Check your connection." data-variant="error">Simulate an error</va-button>
<va-toast id="toaster"></va-toast>
